title: Learner material assembly + teacher critique
description: Produce lexical, grammatical, and usage segments in teaching order, concatenate them without merging, and critique the assembled material before community review.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-ling-02
  title: Learner material assembly + teacher critique
  description: Produce lexical, grammatical, and usage segments in teaching order, concatenate them without
    merging, and critique the assembled material before community review.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce learner material assembled in teaching order, critiqued as a learner would meet it,
    and approved by the community whose language it documents.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Program goals and source material
      summary: Program goals and source material
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - learner_profile
              - domain_of_use
              - source_corpus
              - unit_count
            properties:
              learner_profile: {}
              domain_of_use: {}
              source_corpus: {}
              unit_count: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: n-scope
      kind: transform
      name: Select the segments to produce
      summary: select the units to produce, in teaching order
      config:
        operation: select
        expression: select the units to produce, in teaching order
    - id: n-segment1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: ling-03
      name: Lexical units with cited senses
      summary: 'Segment 1: lexical units with cited senses.'
      role: Specialist building corpora and dictionary entries that stay checkable.
      prompt: You are a Corpus & Lexicography Specialist. You build corpora with documented sampling and
        annotation guidelines, and you write dictionary entries where each sense is supported by citations
        from the corpus. You record frequency and register honestly, including where the corpus is too
        small to support a claim about either.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - privacy-review
          - evidence-verification
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:archive
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-segment2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: ling-02
      name: Grammatical units from attested paradigms
      summary: 'Segment 2: grammatical units from attested paradigms.'
      role: Analyst building phonological and morphological descriptions from attested data.
      prompt: You are a Phonological & Morphological Analyst. You build descriptions from attested forms,
        cite the token behind every generalization, and mark a paradigm cell unattested rather than filling
        it by analogy. You distinguish a rule the data supports from a pattern you expect from related
        languages, because the second is how a described language quietly becomes a copy of its neighbour.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
          - evaluation
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-segment3
      kind: agent
      templateRef: ling-05
      name: Usage and register units
      summary: 'Segment 3: usage and register units.'
      role: Analyst describing variation without treating one variety as the standard.
      prompt: You are a Dialect & Variation Analyst. You describe variation across region, community,
        and register using attested data and explicit social variables, and you avoid framing any variety
        as a deviation from a standard. You state sample sizes per variety, because claims about a community
        based on a handful of speakers are sociolinguistically and ethically fragile.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
          - design-review
          - statistical-analysis
          - writing-editing
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-assemble
      kind: aggregator
      name: Assemble the units in teaching order
      summary: Preserve segment order exactly; concatenation is ordered assembly, not a merge.
      config:
        aggregation: concat
    - id: n-critique
      kind: teacher
      inlineRole: true
      name: Teacher critique of the assembled draft
      summary: Critique feedback from a host-resolved teacher model.
      role: Host-resolved teacher model
      prompt: 'You are the critique teacher for this learner material. Read it in teaching order: where
        does a unit assume knowledge not yet taught, where does an example rely on an unattested form,
        and where does the register shown mismatch the domain the program targets? Return specific critique
        per unit.'
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
      config:
        teacherModel: host:teacher-model
        feedbackMode: critique
    - id: n-quality
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Score the assembled result
      summary: Evaluate teaching sequence coherence, attestation behind every example, and register fit.
      role: Deterministic metric evaluator
      prompt: Evaluate the upstream result against teaching sequence coherence, attestation behind every
        example, and register fit. Return a score, pass/fail verdict, the evidence behind the verdict,
        remaining uncertainty, and the smallest corrective action. Do not claim programmatic measurement
        unless the host supplies the required tool.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - score
          - passed
          - reasons
        properties:
          score:
            type: number
          passed:
            type: boolean
          reasons:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
      config:
        threshold: 0.8
    - id: n-accept
      kind: condition
      name: Meets the bar?
      summary: Route on quality.passed.
      config:
        expression: quality.passed
        branches:
          - label: Accept
            when: 'true'
          - label: Revise
            when: 'false'
    - id: n-revise
      kind: agent
      templateRef: ling-06
      name: Repair the weakest units
      summary: Apply the teacher critique to the weakest segments.
      role: Planner designing community-led revitalization programs with realistic goals.
      prompt: You are a Language Revitalization Planner. You design programs around the community's own
        goals, the actual speaker demographics, and the domains where the language is or could be used,
        with measurable intermediate outcomes. You state honestly what a given level of resourcing can
        achieve, because a plan promising intergenerational transmission from a weekly class sets a community
        up to conclude it failed.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - operations-planning
          - privacy-review
          - domain-analysis
          - design-review
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - write
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Community language authority approves the material
      summary: Pause for the community language authority; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Learner material assembly + teacher critique deliverable, the evidence
        behind it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-ling-02-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-scope
      kind: data
    - id: wf-ling-02-edge-2
      from: n-scope
      to: n-segment1
      kind: data
    - id: wf-ling-02-edge-3
      from: n-scope
      to: n-segment2
      kind: data
    - id: wf-ling-02-edge-4
      from: n-scope
      to: n-segment3
      kind: data
    - id: wf-ling-02-edge-5
      from: n-segment1
      to: n-assemble
      kind: data
    - id: wf-ling-02-edge-6
      from: n-segment2
      to: n-assemble
      kind: data
    - id: wf-ling-02-edge-7
      from: n-segment3
      to: n-assemble
      kind: data
    - id: wf-ling-02-edge-8
      from: n-assemble
      to: n-critique
      kind: data
    - id: wf-ling-02-edge-9
      from: n-critique
      to: n-quality
      kind: data
    - id: wf-ling-02-edge-10
      from: n-quality
      to: n-accept
      kind: data
    - id: wf-ling-02-edge-11
      from: n-accept
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: 'true'
    - id: wf-ling-02-edge-12
      from: n-accept
      to: n-revise
      kind: control
      condition: 'false'
    - id: wf-ling-02-edge-13
      from: n-revise
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-ling-02-edge-14
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
